purpose: Production gate for assets introduced by feat/kaki-world-asset-overhaul. Every new third-party production file requires a GREEN row. No BIMobject source qualified.
reviewer: OpenAI Codex technical-art and rights review

gate.green: Explicit permission for transformation, interactive-game inclusion, public hosting, redistribution, commercial use, and continued inclusion after modification; or project-owned original clean-room work.
gate.yellow: Downloadable but one or more required rights are unclear. Ignored private staging only; never in source, build, Pages, or promotional captures.
gate.red: Terms prohibit required use, rights cannot be verified, permission is refused, or branding is inseparable. Not acquired, shipped, or recreated.
gate.publicBuildRule: Only GREEN assets may appear under assets/ or a production manifest. asset_staging/ is ignored and no manifest may reference it.

bimobjectDetermination.consequence: No BIMobject geometry, texture, material, metadata, or measurement entered the repository. Product records are research rejections only. The public production derivatives below are independently authored from generic functional requirements.

materialAndDecalSources.materials: Flat metal/rough PBR values authored in tools/blender/kaki_world_kit_common.py; no image textures, scans, or manufacturer material files.
materialAndDecalSources.decals: Geometry-only fictional paw badges and Kaki color blocking generated by the same builder; no real logo, sponsor, manufacturer, or jurisdictional sign art.
